problems.python:
"""52. N-Queens II (Hard).

Specification: https://leetcode.com/problems/n-queens-ii/description/
"""


def solve(n: int) -> int:
    count = 0
    columns = set()
    diagonals = set()
    anti_diagonals = set()

    def backtrack(row):
        nonlocal count
        if row == n:
            count += 1
            return
        for col in range(n):
            if col in columns or (row - col) in diagonals or (row + col) in anti_diagonals:
                continue
            columns.add(col)
            diagonals.add(row - col)
            anti_diagonals.add(row + col)
            backtrack(row + 1)
            columns.remove(col)
            diagonals.remove(row - col)
            anti_diagonals.remove(row + col)

    backtrack(0)
    return count


class Solution:
    def totalNQueens(self, n: int) -> int:
        return solve(n)

problems.python:
"""123. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III (Hard).

Specification: https://leetcode.com/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-iii/description/
"""


def solve(prices: list[int]) -> int:
    buy1 = float('-inf')
    sell1 = 0
    buy2 = float('-inf')
    sell2 = 0
    for price in prices:
        buy1 = max(buy1, -price)
        sell1 = max(sell1, buy1 + price)
        buy2 = max(buy2, sell1 - price)
        sell2 = max(sell2, buy2 + price)
    return sell2


class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, prices: list[int]) -> int:
        return solve(prices)

problems.python:
"""152. Maximum Product Subarray (Medium).

Specification: https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-product-subarray/description/
"""


def solve(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    best = nums[0]
    max_ending = nums[0]
    min_ending = nums[0]
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        value = nums[i]
        candidates = [value, max_ending * value, min_ending * value]
        max_ending = max(candidates)
        min_ending = min(candidates)
        best = max(best, max_ending)
    return best


class Solution:
    def maxProduct(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        return solve(nums)
